# Public catalog regression sample

Four representative institution rows copied from the already imported public release `web_79f1397603c1e28325955f64` on 2026-09-12. They cover EDWETHINK source/phone provenance, a KPM directory claim, a record without coordinates and a held record. No owner, parent or child data is included. These inputs are used only by tests; the website still reads the live public Appwrite catalog.

The prior full-catalog regional audit is retained in `evidence/region-validation.json`. Normal tests no longer depend on a sibling workspace directory or overwrite that historical audit.
